name: SWE-NFI
description: Although coding agents have achieved impressive performance on correctness-oriented benchmarks, their ability to make behavior-preserving non-functional improvements (NFIs) remains underexplored. In real-world software development, developers continuously improve software quality without changing observable behavior, yet existing benchmarks primarily evaluate functional correctness and provide limited support for assessing these non-functional improvements. In this paper, we present SWE-NFI, a benchmark for evaluating coding agents on NFIs beyond functional correctness.
